arguments.command:
python -c "
import parse

# Test that +0100 and +01:00 produce equal FixedTzOffset objects
fmt = 'a {:ti} b'
result_0100 = parse.parse(fmt, 'a 1997-07-16T19:20+0100 b')
result_01_00 = parse.parse(fmt, 'a 1997-07-16T19:20+01:00 b')

print(f'Result +0100: {result_0100}')
print(f'Result +01:00: {result_01_00}')
print(f'tzinfo +0100: {result_0100.group(\"ti\").tzinfo}')
print(f'tzinfo +01:00: {result_01_00.group(\"ti\").tzinfo}')
print(f'Equal? {result_0100.group(\"ti\").tzinfo == result_01_00.group(\"ti\").tzinfo}')
print(f'Name +0100: {result_0100.group(\"ti\").tzinfo._name}')
print(f'Name +01:00: {result_01_00.group(\"ti\").tzinfo._name}')

# Also test with leading space
result_space = parse.parse(fmt, 'a 1997-07-16T19:20 +0100 b')
print(f'Result +space+0100: {result_space.group(\"ti\").tzinfo._name}')
"
